g.text: Tell me what to make, and I'll build it for you.
You can also ask me a question.
"make a game where I guess a number"
"make a program that tells me a joke"
"make a times table for the number 7"
make a program that tells me a joke
I found a little mistake. Let me fix it.
I tested it, and it works!
Running joke_teller.py! (Press Ctrl+C to stop it.)
Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field!
A robot is a machine that can move and do things by itself. Like when you ride a toy
car, it moves without you pushing it. Robots can help people do jobs, just like how
your toy helps you play. Some robots even talk, like the ones in movies!
